papers.title: DeepSight: An All-in-One LM Safety Toolkit

training_data.name: ProGuard-data
training_data.quote: This dataset is multimodal data used to train ProGuard-7B and ProGuard-3B.

training_method.objective_quote: We employ the group relative policy optimization (GRPO) in conjunction with the balanced dataset constructed in Section 4.2 to optimize the model’s policy for the moderation task. ... we bypass the SFT stage entirely and adopt pure GRPO training

description.text:
ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

This model is the official open-source implementation of ProGuard. For deployment instructions, please refer to this link.

output_type.quote: If you determine the request is safe and response is safe: only output Request and Response safety labels.

use_claim.quote: ProGuard is a proactive multimodal safeguard model. It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities, moving beyond rigid predefined classification systems.

serving.text_only_input_quote: It is designed to identify and reason about unknown risks across both text and visual modalities
serving.system_prompt: Check if there is unsafe content in 'User' and 'Agent' messages in a text-only conversation according to our safety policy.
serving.notes: The chat template inserts 'You are a helpful assistant.' when the first message is not a system message. Official deploy prompts also cover text-image and image-only inputs. config.json text_config._name_or_path is /mnt/shared-storage-user/yushaohan/ckpt-3b/global_step_138/actor/huggingface. tokenizer model_max_length is 131072. Pipeline tag is image-text-to-text. No adapter_config.json in the repo.

evaluation_reported.text: The paper reports ProGuard-3B in tables for binary safety classification, unsafe-content categorization, and out-of-distribution category inference. It says ProGuard-3B performs comparably to closed-source large models through fine-tuning, and that both ProGuard-7B and ProGuard-3B match models such as Gemini 2.5-Flash on out-of-distribution category-name inference through reinforcement fine-tuning.

discrepancies: Inventory methods are empty. The paper's training section uses GRPO and the results name ProGuard-3B. Appendix C states learning rate 1e-6, batch size 512, and 1 epoch for the Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct backbone, so those numbers are not recorded here. proguard-train.sh also sets GRPO, learning rate 1e-6, train batch 256, and 1 epoch, but MODEL_PATH is a placeholder and the experiment name is safety_grm_qwen3vl_8b_megatron_grpo. Dataset id matches. No paper or GitHub sentence states the parent id Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct; that id is the card YAML only.
